# Resolve bundle

## Rules
- Output: `ResolveBundleOutput { bundle: SkillBundle }`.
- Input: `ResolveBundleInput { name: string; config?: SpecdConfig; context?: SkillTemplateContext }`; default empty context; recursive `context.variables`.
- With `config`, inject only safe built-ins: `configPath` privacy-safe relative runtime path; `schemaRef: config.schemaRef`; missing `variables.sharedFolder` default relative path from runtime config directory.
- Strip trailing `/` from `variables.sharedFolder`; validate resolved path stays within `projectRoot`; never expose `projectRoot`; rendered `sharedFolder` remains relative.
- Merge built-ins + install context; `SkillRepository.getBundle(input.name, mergedContext)`.
- Render template recursively using `variables` + capabilities. `variables.frontmatter` composes frontmatter only if `frontmatter` capability present.
- Preserve all non-content `ResolvedFile` metadata, including shared flag; return resolved bundle.
- Plugin installs needing `configPath`, `schemaRef`, default `sharedFolder` must use this use case, not repository direct.
- `specd-fasttrack`: generic repository path only; preserve built-ins, capability IDs, structured frontmatter, shared routing; no fast-track resolver branch. Keep conditional workflow only for target capabilities; shared files no runtime skill frontmatter.

## Constraints
- Invocation supplies install render context.
- Repository must not invent missing capability/frontmatter values.
- `variables.frontmatter` alone must not emit frontmatter; capability gates it.
